answer: Require each agent to post a bond from an account with a time-locked, nontransferable history, then slash that bond when the agent’s actions are proven fraudulent. Splitting one identity into many does not multiply influence for free: every new account must acquire its own aged history and risk capital, which remains locked and can be destroyed. A relic market might price saffron shipments across the tundra, but the attacker still pays in time and forfeitable funds for each fake trader.
